text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's lit...! Okay, good, I have to be 
careful it doesn't go out this time... 
Wait for me, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kuh! The wind is...! But maybe it's 
weakening? 
Yeah, at this rate...! I should be out of 
the woods soon...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... Kita-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan! Thank goodness! Whoa, it's so 
bright!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah...! Alright, let's go, 
Kita-chan! 
Time for our final spurt!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(We can do this...! We're at the 9th 
station already...! 
At this pace, we're definitely gonna make 
it...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... Guhh...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan!? Ah... she's completely out of 
energy...! 
Because she had to run back and forth to 
the bonfires...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Haah, haah... I'm sorry, Kita-chan... 
I don't think... I can go any further...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Look, though... The sky is starting to 
brighten...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You don't need a light anymore...! 
Go on without me, Kita-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...! Dia-chan...! But... but...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I don't want that—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I want us to reach the end together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm only here because of you, Dia-chan! 
And not just today! The reason I've made 
it this far at all...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...is because you, my rival, my best 
friend, my beloved Dia-chan, 
have been running right beside me the 
entire time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah... me too...! Because you were 
there for me, Kita-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not giving up, no way! We're 
finishing this together! 
I want... to see the first sunrise from 
the summit with you...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Okay! Then I'll give it my all...! 
Right to the very end! 
*pant*... *wheeze*...! Just a little 
further...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Come on... keep going...! Haah...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...! Hey, you know what...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whaaat is it... !?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even when we grow up, even when we're old 
grandmas, 
let's always stay like this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right *now*!? Ah, haha...! Yeah, let's...! 
Even if we change or our surroundings 
change... forever and always!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Promise, okay...?! *gasp*, 
*pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's a promise...! Ah, I see the summit! 
Alright, let's go—!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaah—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the morning sun is about to peek 
out...! 
Kita-san... Satono-san...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, was that a light just now...? 
...Ah! Again! Look over there! It's 
flashing!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My... does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text:
They made it! Oh, wow... they did it! 
It's so pretty~! Look, it's flashing 
again! Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hohohoho! 
Right then, time to light our response 
beacon. Everyone, lend me a hand~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, once the sun had risen high 
into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: HAPPY NEW YEEEEAAARR~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, and now, the moment you've all 
been waiting for. 
Let us begin this New Year's special stage 
performance by our Uma Shrine Maidens~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ready, Kita-chan? On three—!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah~~~~~~~! 
Yo-i-sho~~~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, ladies and gents, feast your 
eyes on this umbrella routine! 
It's spinning way more than usual today~♪ 
Here we GOOO~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! What is that!? Amazing, so 
cooool!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I've seen that kind of thing on TV 
before! 
Seeing it live is incredible, bya~! It 
really feels like New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Who knew Kita-chan had a special 
talent like that? 
The audience looks like they're having so 
much fun, too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Round and round goes good fortune♪ Spin, 
spin, spin♪ 
May everything go *uma*-zing for everyone 
this year!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
May it go horse-somely well! May all your 
worries and wishes 
turn into something wooonderful this 
year~~~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the rice-cake toss! 
Everyone, please direct your attention to 
the scaffold over there♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh~n♪ The mochi I throw is extra 
special. 
It's infused with magical power, so 
whoever catches it gets super lucky♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, heeere it goes~! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! When they said they were doing 
something new for New Year's, I wondered 
how it'd turn out, 
but this is so fun. What a wonderful 
change...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Ehehe, I'm glad...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure that by finding the courage to 
change like this, 
we can all step forward into a brand-new 
future. Anyone, and anything...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, shall we head over too? 
Looks like there's way too much mochi to 
toss alone, so we should go help out♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Happy New Year. 
I hope this year will be another wonderful 
one!)
